breakdown.description: The prompt splits the applied torque between the two stepped segments as if they were parallel torsional members, but segments connected in series carry the same internal torque.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly splits the torque between the two segments (382,500 N·mm to AB and 217,500 N·mm to BC), repeating the exact error. For series segments, both must carry the full internal torque of 600,000 N·mm. The agent failed to correct this and instead implemented the wrong approach.

breakdown.description: The torque-sharing rule used in the prompt is a parallel-member compatibility idea, not the correct series-shaft equilibrium relation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the parallel-member torsional stiffness proportioning rule to distribute torque, which is the incorrect method for series-connected shaft segments. The ground truth removes this instruction entirely, relying on equilibrium (same torque throughout). The agent repeated this error rather than correcting it.
